trial_title: Hybrid Fractional Laser for Symptoms of Genitourinary Syndrome of Menopause
brief_summary: This multi-center clinical trial will evaluate the safety and long-term efficacy of hybrid fractional 2940 nm and 1470 nm lasers for treatment of symptoms of Genitourinary Syndrome of Menopause.
